This must cover every transition the old test covered. (b) Seeded defect: in a tmp_path copy of data/stories/continuity-initiative (shutil.copytree; edit YAML with yaml.safe_load/safe_dump like the existing tests do), make the smallest edit that still loads where one realization of a storylet in a transition's source scene no longer establishes the exit fact and no bridge event or delivery can set it either (for example point it at a different unlisted outcome), and assert the rule flags that realization.
